title: Schedule of Included Services, Linden Memberships
content:
The services included in each tier of Linden Memberships, beyond the monthly visit credits, are listed here. Counted inclusions (home visits and guest passes) are per membership year; the other inclusions are either part of the tier or not.

## Counted inclusions per membership year

| Tier | Home visits included | Guest passes (visits a member may give to a non-member guest) |
|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 0 | 0 |
| Linden Essential Membership | 0 | 0 |
| Linden Family Membership | 0 | 0 |
| Linden Plus Membership | 0 | 1 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 2 | 2 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 4 | 4 |

## Included or not

| Tier | Annual wellness visit without using a credit | Comprehensive executive physical each membership year | Generic medications dispensed in-office at wholesale cost | Care coordinator for referrals and authorizations | Pre-travel consultations and vaccine counselling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | No | No | No | No | No |
| Linden Essential Membership | Yes | No | Yes | No | No |
| Linden Family Membership | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Linden Plus Membership | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

- Only the Linden Executive Health Membership includes the comprehensive executive physical.
- Travel medicine (pre-travel consultations and vaccine counselling) is included on the Linden Premier Concierge Membership and the Linden Executive Health Membership only.
- The Linden Connect Virtual Membership includes none of the services in the second table and no home visits or guest passes.
- Hypothetical: a Linden Premier Concierge Membership member who has used 2 home visits in the current membership year has used the tier's full home visit inclusion for that year; a Linden Plus Membership member has 1 guest pass for the membership year.
